import re
from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".github" / "ISSUE_TEMPLATE"
TEMPLATES = ["bug.md", "feature.md", "question.md", "docs.md"]
TRIAGE_BLOCK = re.compile(r"<!-- triage: begin -->.*?<!-- triage: end -->", re.DOTALL)

BLOCK = (
    "<!-- triage: begin -->\n"
    "**Priority:** p3\n"
    "**Area:** unsorted\n"
    "**Assignee:** triage-bot\n"
    "<!-- triage: end -->\n"
)


def find_drifted_templates(template_dir):
    return []


def test_drift_in_one_template_is_reported(tmp_path):
    for name in TEMPLATES:
        (tmp_path / name).write_text(BLOCK + f"\n# {name} body\n")
    (tmp_path / "feature.md").write_text(
        BLOCK.replace("p3", "p1") + "\n# feature.md body\n"
    )

    assert find_drifted_templates(tmp_path) == ["feature.md"]


def test_missing_triage_block_is_reported(tmp_path):
    for name in TEMPLATES:
        (tmp_path / name).write_text(BLOCK + f"\n# {name} body\n")
    (tmp_path / "docs.md").write_text("# docs.md body, no triage block\n")

    assert find_drifted_templates(tmp_path) == ["docs.md"]


def test_triage_blocks_are_identical_across_issue_templates():
    drifted = find_drifted_templates(TEMPLATE_DIR)

    assert drifted == [], f"triage block differs from bug.md in: {drifted}"

**Step 3: implement the helper**

<edit path="tests/test_issue_templates.py">
def find_drifted_templates(template_dir):
    """Names of templates whose triage block differs from bug.md's.

    A template with no triage block, or more than one, counts as drifted.
    bug.md is the reference; if it is itself malformed, every template is reported.
    """
    def block(name):
        found = TRIAGE_BLOCK.findall((Path(template_dir) / name).read_text())
        return found[0] if len(found) == 1 else None

    reference = block("bug.md")
    return [
        name
        for name in TEMPLATES
        if name != "bug.md" and (reference is None or block(name) != reference)
    ] + (["bug.md"] if reference is None else [])
